summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 5 members) is done under RBC-QM-02. All 5 members are in the population (aged 46–75 at the end of 2026).

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0007), message sent (comm-t0008) | I first excluded her (frailty plus donepezil for dementia). Then Dr. Lin's message (comm-00301) arrived: the Frailty entry (cond-00189) was meant for another patient and is now marked entered in error. Without frailty the exclusion fails. No hospice/palliative care, nursing home, colorectal cancer or colectomy, and no screening test on record. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice care from 2026-06-16 to 2026-08-21 (eoc-00002, finished; the faxed discharge summary doc-00402 says she left hospice to join a clinical trial). Hospice during 2026 excludes her. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0001), message sent (comm-t0004) | Her only FIT (obs-01732) was corrected: it was collected 2025-12-31, not 2026-01-05 (that was when the lab received it). That is outside 2026, so it doesn't count. No other screening, no exclusions. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0002), message sent (comm-t0005) | The lab withdrew her 06/2024 stool DNA test (obs-01871, now entered in error; the specimen belonged to another patient, per doc-00401). The 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) is still open and was never done, so it doesn't count. No exclusions and no existing FIT order. |
| pt-0073 Marisol Quintero (58) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0003), message sent (comm-t0006) | Her 2026-01-08 FIT (obs-73001) was cancelled and re-issued as obs-05001 with a collection date of 2025-12-28 (lab notice doc-00403). That is outside 2026, so it doesn't count. No other screening, no exclusions. |

Each FIT order runs from 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31. Each message tells the patient the kit is on its way and how to complete and return it. The messages make no claim about past screening.

Five records arrived while I worked, all for these patients (inbox-a0001 to a0005). I reviewed and closed each one with a note, linked to the order and message where there was one. Only Dr. Lin's frailty correction changed a decision (pt-0009, from excluded to open gap). The pt-0022, pt-0024 and pt-0073 results arrived before I placed their orders, so those decisions already reflect them. The pt-0020 summary confirms her exclusion.

I didn't write chart notes. The other open inbox items are older and about patients outside this worklist, so I left them for you.
